title: plasma-nm fails to read a SAML cookie for a GlobalProtect VPN, then crashes in QWidgetPrivate::windowHandle()
line: Cancelling a passkey prompt during an OpenConnect/GlobalProtect SAML login no longer crashes the network service when the login page asks again.
explanation: The OpenConnect auth widget opens a WebAuth (passkey) dialog with WA_DeleteOnClose and keeps a raw pointer to it. When the request is cancelled or completed the dialog closes and deletes itself, but the pointer is never cleared, so when the SAML page reloads and asks for a passkey again, handleWebAuthUxRequested() calls close() on the freed dialog and kded6 segfaults (the reporter's backtrace). The pointer is now a QPointer, which becomes null when the dialog is deleted, and the update branch checks it too.

commits.message:
openconnect: don't close a WebAuth dialog that was already deleted

The WebAuth dialog deletes itself when closed, but the pointer to it
was kept, so the next passkey request after the login page reloaded
called close() on freed memory and crashed kded. Track it with QPointer.

BUG: 515706

media.caption: Master: after Cancel the page reloads, asks again and kded6 crashes; the VPN dialog is gone
Master: Connect, passkey prompt, Cancel, crash
Fix: after Cancel the page reloads and a fresh passkey prompt opens, kded6 keeps running
Fix: two Cancel/reload cycles, then the VPN dialog is cancelled normally

review.text: Tracking `OpenconnectAuthWidgetPrivate::authDialog` with a `QPointer` and null-checking it in the `else` branch of `handleWebAuthUxStateChanged()` directly fixes the exact use-after-free crash in `kded6` when the `WA_DeleteOnClose` WebAuth dialog is closed and a subsequent passkey request arrives. The diff is minimal, safe across dialog close/cancel and parent widget destruction, and well-verified against a local SAML/WebAuthn reproducer matching the reporter's backtrace.

reviews.text: Tracking `OpenconnectAuthWidgetPrivate::authDialog` with a `QPointer` and null-checking it in the `else` branch of `handleWebAuthUxStateChanged()` directly fixes the exact use-after-free crash in `kded6` when the `WA_DeleteOnClose` WebAuth dialog is closed and a subsequent passkey request arrives. The diff is minimal, safe across dialog close/cancel and parent widget destruction, and well-verified against a local SAML/WebAuthn reproducer matching the reporter's backtrace.

The crash part is correctly diagnosed and fixed: authDialog is WA_DeleteOnClose but was a raw pointer, so the next WebAuth request called close() on freed memory; QPointer plus the null check in the update branch is the right minimal fix, and the before/after-2 pair and verify notes prove it. But the bug (and Nate's retitle) is also that plasma-nm fails to read the GlobalProtect SAML cookie, and that is not server-side: OpenconnectAuthWidget calls openconnect_webview_load_changed() with res.headers = nullptr, while openconnect's gpst_sso_detect_done() only looks for saml-username and prelogin-cookie/portal-userauthcookie in result->headers, so a GP SAML login through plasma-nm's webview can never complete. With only this commit the reporter still cannot connect, so BUG: 515706 would close the report prematurely.
changes: Make GlobalProtect SAML complete in plasma-nm's openconnect webview: pass the saml-username and prelogin-cookie/portal-userauthcookie values to openconnect_webview_load_changed() (e.g. from the final page's HTML comment block that GP gateways emit, since QtWebEngine exposes no response headers) and verify a GP SAML login finishes on a fake GP gateway; otherwise downgrade this commit to CCBUG and keep the bug open for the SAML part.
Keep the QPointer crash fix as is (it can be a separate commit).
